assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the two reviewed items curated on tomozaki:izumi-yuzu@light-novel at basis_commit, each read in full: #provisional-character-study, the canonical Izumi Yuzu character monograph (generation V12_REVIEWED_YUZU, maturity MATURE_LOCAL_LITERARY_ROLE, accepted scope A, independent review pass 2026-10-23) over the verified Japanese main V01-V12 with story-locally routed V06.5/V08.5, whose register IY-R01 to IY-R11 gives selective primary windows for V04, V05, V06.5, V08, V11 and V12 and routes other bands to sequential readings and ledgers; and #bounded-reconstruction-model, the canonical derived-use model with root construction admission MR-P07 (model core V1), marked do_not_use_as_primary_literary_authority, which derives from that monograph and is not used as literary evidence. The project's current-state entrypoint and the models README were read for method and gate state only. The V12/principal and R06 integration review, principal B model integration review, evidence packets, readings, ledgers, voice ledger and full-series synthesis to which these items route are not curated on this subject and are not evidence here. Much of her conduct is filtered through Fumiya; V06.5 is her own focalization and is not his knowledge. No adaptation, performed voice, reception or post-V12 material is in scope.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: The model's eleven selectors: IY-S1 V01 early learner, IY-S2 V03-V04 peer/captain, IY-S3 V04 discreet inquiry, IY-S4 V05 re-entry, IY-S5 V06-V07 public work, IY-S6 V06.5 private uncertainty (story-local clock), IY-S7 V08-V09 ordinary future and collaboration, IY-S8 V10 birthday planner, IY-S9 V11 absent handoff, IY-S10 V12 delivery and IY-S11 V12 ordinary audience, with the monograph's V02 chronology row as context. Selectors are configurations, not a maturation ranking; reader access to a private scene stays with the reader; Hinami's V12 private appraisal is not distributed back to the birthday group; the V11-V12 interval is off-page; nothing after V12 is established.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The monograph's thesis, social maintenance as owned agency whose competence hides its cost (sections 2, 5-7), separates reason ownership from capacity governance, is tested against rival readings (sections 12 and 20), and is operationalized as the model's distinction between a chosen relation, work she can do and work she can sustainably absorb (YM1-YM7). B is rejected because section 17 states there is no single quantified or invariant priority ordering, the state vector gives self-concept and confidence only medium confidence, and stopping conditions are named the principal unresolved variable, which the model excludes. D is rejected because a reviewed A-scope monograph with tested rivals exceeds distributed evidence.

The section 3 chronology gives ten bands V01-V12 with an analytical limit each, and the model's eleven selectors each name an excluded transfer (later couple security not backdated to the V01 learner; V11 refusal not her threshold; V12 delivery not filling the interval). A is rejected because the V02-V03 and V08-V09 bands are thin, many bands rest on routed readings rather than primary windows in the monograph, and the V11-to-V12 change is off-page. C is rejected because the states are selector-bound with explicit negative transfer controls across the whole run.

Section 19 locates recipient-specific speech acts: the V08 playful line and praise request to Fumiya (part0014 P163-175, quoted), the V11 report, proposal, self-blame and group apology sequence (p-0016 P164-222), and the V12 wave whose words are unheard; the model cites attested hesitant refusal and bright facilitation and records a selective local written-register review. C is rejected because the attested sample is a few local acts and one short quotation, and the model states no idiolect, particle or honorific profile is established and no freeform Japanese is generated. E is rejected because register contrast across recipients is located with primary windows.

Ordinary preference is directly evidenced: V06.5 clothing judgment, correction of a friend's jacket and photographic skill (part0029 P105-164, focalized), the V08 Aogaku wish (part0014 P150-176) and V10 remembered-preference planning, with section 9 and the model's YM3 giving ordinary taste its own place. B is rejected because section 15 states her home life is sparsely available and the model forbids extrapolating a fixed taste catalogue, routine or career. D is rejected because several fresh windows show her own preferences rather than services.

The section 18 recipient table (Nakamura, Fumiya, Konno, Tama, Hinami, wider group, V12 audience) and model section 3 give distinct supported variation and limits per recipient, with primary windows for Nakamura (V06.5, V11), Konno (V06.5 P245-303), Fumiya (V08) and Hinami (V10 routes). A is rejected because private reciprocity with Nakamura is open, the Tama row is largely thematic contrast, and section 18 warns that evidence from one recipient cannot set its force for another. C is rejected because the variation is explicit, tested and located across multiple recipients.

V06.5 supplies direct internal focalization of her pleasure in being consulted, her fear of a breakup and her moral judgment of Konno's earlier harassment (part0029 P105-164, P245-303, P485-543), and V11 shows direct guilt. B is rejected because outside that one supplemental story her interior is filtered through Fumiya, the state vector rates self-concept medium, and section 15 says her reasons for every accommodation remain sparsely available. D is rejected because directly focalized private states exist.

Conflict behavior is located across distinct modes: V04 timed discreet inquiry under Konno's attention (p-0031 P213-230, P250-279), V05 re-entry support for Konno after the crowd turns (part0028), and V11 proposal, self-blame and following Nakamura after his refusal (p-0016 P164-222); the model's YM2 and YM7 bound these. B is rejected because no severe refusal is attested, section 17 leaves her stopping threshold and priority among partner, friends and duty open, and the model returns ranges rather than an act for new burdens. D is rejected because three conflict modes rest on primary windows.

She holds a focalized moral judgment of Konno's harassment while valuing her company (V06.5), separates inclusion from accountability in practice (V05), and voices self-blame the monograph distinguishes from responsibility (V11). B is rejected because the governing distinctions (re-entry versus justice, sincerity versus knowledge versus permission versus effect) are largely the monograph's analytical evaluation, and her own capacity or permission reasoning is not shown. D is rejected because her own moral judgment is directly focalized and located.

Play is located in V08, where she laughs at her own fashionable reason and playfully asks Fumiya for praise (part0014 P150-176), and in V06.5, where friends credit and tease her photographic skill (part0029 P105-164). C is rejected because only two local scenes are given and no humor style is analysed. E is rejected because both are located primary windows treated as her own acts.

The monograph is an independently reviewed A-scope account through V12 with selective primary windows for V04, V05, V06.5, V08, V11 and V12 in its IY-R register. B is rejected because V01-V03, V06-V07, V09 and V10 are carried by routed readings and ledgers rather than primary windows in the curated items, the full-series synthesis it routes to is described as a pre-remediation hypothesis inventory, and relationship, convergence and release gates remain separate. D is rejected because a reviewed mature monograph with primary windows across the run exceeds distributed evidence.

Affirmative limits and corrections are located: the Akiyama/group apology to Tama is real while Konno's own apology is absent (V05 part0028 P17-24), Konno's phone-taking precedes assent and later assent does not erase it (V06.5 P245-303), Yuzu's fear differs from the meeting's actual gift purpose (P485-543), Nakamura's refusal is his and not her threshold (V11), and her V12 words are unheard (p-0026 P212-234). A is rejected because her durable absorber boundary is an evidence gap, not affirmative evidence, and several limits rest on one scene. C is rejected because the limits are explicit, corrected against countercases and primary-located.

Each selector binds an era and actor-known information: V06.5 keeps its story-local clock, Hinami's V12 private trigger appraisal is not distributed back to the V10 birthday group, and the V11 refusal and V12 delivery stay separate states. A is rejected because the V11-to-V12 interval is unshown and some bands are thin or routed. C is rejected because era and knowledge controls are explicit for every selector.

scenario_readiness.note: The model generates no freeform Japanese and states that no idiolect, particle or honorific profile is established; attested speech is a few local acts and one short quotation, and the V12 words are explicitly unheard. CONDITIONAL would treat local communicative-act controls as a voice. NOT_ASSESSED is rejected because the evidence explicitly bounds voice.

conditions: One named selector only, with its actor-known information and route; reader-only private material and Hinami's family history are not transferred.
Only the model's admitted domain: relationship-motivated learning, familiar peer coordination and timed inquiry, ordinary taste consultation, small event or birthday planning and festival work.

Output is a labeled hypothetical act or range that keeps continuing, narrowing, sharing, postponing or declining open where workload or cooperation is unspecified, and abstains on any capacity threshold, couple agreement or career.
Behavior is described in prose; no quoted speech is generated as canonical.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: A single model selector from IY-S1 to IY-S11 within Japanese V01-V12, with V06.5 on its story-local clock; no post-V12 state.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Only attested recipients in their selector-specific standing: Nakamura, Fumiya, Konno, Tama, Hinami, Hirabayashi, the festival or class group and the V12 audience.
setting_constraints: Familiar school peer coordination, relationship-motivated learning, ordinary taste consultation, small event or birthday planning and festival work of the Japanese light novels
Workload, request, available cooperation and known preferences supplied; hidden Hinami family meaning is not actor knowledge
No durable refusal or delegation threshold, private couple agreement, household, career, finance, unfamiliar professional management or clinical domain
Output is a labeled hypothetical act or range, never an observed canonical event

scenario_readiness.note: The model explicitly admits conditional synthetic outputs for new familiar learning requests, consultations and small events (YM1, YM3, YM6) with an ordered input gate. READY is rejected because the model excludes her stable refusal and delegation threshold, the central unresolved variable of the monograph, and voice is unvalidated. NOT_READY is rejected because bounded novel acts inside the admitted domains are explicitly supported with stated confidence.

conditions: Only familiar peer company and coordination: friend consultation on taste, photographs, outings, school-group planning and ordinary banter, as near analogs of the V06.5 outing, V08 school conversation and V10 planning returns.
Recipient, known preferences and actual alternatives are supplied; if taste information is absent, ask rather than fill it from an agreeable-person stereotype.
No invented home life, fixed favorites, uniform or career; behavior is described in prose and no quoted speech is generated as canonical.
scenario_readiness.note: Ordinary preference and company are directly evidenced and the model's YM3 supports concrete discriminating opinions in comparable choices. READY is rejected because home life is sparsely available and the model rates comparable familiar choices only modest. NOT_READY is rejected because the domain is admitted and primary-located.

Her moral judgment of Konno and her V11 guilt are located, but the model abstains on any stable ordering of partner, friend, duty and self, and the monograph's governing ethical distinctions are its own evaluation. CONDITIONAL would generate her deliberation in new dilemmas from analytical distinctions she is not shown to make. NOT_ASSESSED is rejected because the relevant judgments are directly evidenced.

Relationship-motivated learning (V01), V06.5 private fear and direct declaration, and following Nakamura in V11 are located, but the monograph leaves private reciprocity and stopping rules open and the model rates new romantic uncertainty restricted. CONDITIONAL would model new couple interaction from one private supplemental scene. NOT_ASSESSED is rejected because the relationship is substantively evidenced.

Her public work is school-local festival chairing and the V11 council handoff; the monograph says leadership establishes neither capacity nor a vocation, and the model excludes unfamiliar professional management and career outcomes. School event work is covered under MUNDANE_SOCIAL and CROSS_SCENARIO conditions, not as professional readiness. NOT_ASSESSED is rejected because the public-work evidence is located and explicitly limited.

known_limits.statement: Owning a relationship or group reason does not establish fair distribution, sustainable workload or easy refusal; volunteering is not evidence of unlimited capacity.
In V05 Akiyama and other group members apologize to Tama; Konno's own apology, restitution and restored trust are not shown, and Yuzu's re-entry support is not accountability.
In V06.5 Konno takes Kawaguchi Mutsumi's phone before her reply and then obtains assent before sending; later assent does not erase the taking, and Yuzu's gratitude does not show she ordered it.
Yuzu's V06.5 fear of a breakup is her private focalization; the meeting is for a birthday gift, and reader access to that interior is not shown as communicated to Fumiya or Nakamura.
The V10 plan produces Hinami's genuine pleasure and is sincere, but the group lacks Hinami's family history; later injury does not prove the care false, and guilt does not prove sole responsibility.
In V11 Nakamura's refusal and protest against her self-blame are his acts; her apology and choice to follow are hers and do not establish her own capacity threshold or a private agreement.

In V12 the intervening agreement before delivery is not shown, Hinami's apology and trap theories are hers, and Yuzu's final words at the audience scene are masked by Takei; only the wave is evidenced.
The V08 Aogaku wish is her stated educational preference with a reported model-school link; it is not admission, feasibility, a modeling vocation, verified biography or romantic invitation.
No durable refusal, delegation or capacity threshold, and no reciprocity or stopping rule within her relationship with Nakamura, is established.

The V01-V03, V06-V07, V09 and V10 bands are carried by routed readings and ledgers that are not curated on this subject; the curated monograph gives primary windows only for V04, V05, V06.5, V08, V11 and V12.
No idiolect, particle or honorific profile, pitch or performed voice is established; no freeform Japanese or blind accuracy is validated.
Home life, household rules and the reasons for every accommodation remain sparsely available.
Nothing after the V12 boundary, and no career, adult, household or clinical domain, is evidenced.
